description: Fetch one FCC ULS license or spectrum lease in full by callsign or unique system identifier (USI): licensee (the lessee on a lease), status and key dates, its locations with coordinates, elevation, structure height, and ASR number, each location's antennas, each antenna's authorized frequencies with power, ERP/EIRP, station class, transmitter, and emission designators, and the microwave paths it transmits on (receive location and antenna, receive coordinates, receiving callsign); geographic-area licenses list their market and spectrum blocks, and lease links are shown in both directions. Large records are paged: one call lists whole locations up to 50 sites, 100 antennas, and 100 paths, up to max_frequencies frequency rows, and 100 leases, and names the location_offset or lease_offset that reads the rest; location_number starts the locations at a location number the search tools return. Technical detail is kept for active, pending-legal, and term-pending records only. A callsign shared by several records returns the active one, else the most recent.

callsign.description: Callsign or lease ID, e.g. "KNKA123" or "L000012345". Case, spaces, and one trailing portable suffix ("/4") are normalized. Pass this or usi, not both.

lease_offset.description: Lease to start at, counted from 0 in lease-ID order; pass nextLeaseOffset from the previous call to read the next 100.

location_number.description: Location number to start at: the locationNumber of a fcc_spectrum_find_transmitters or fcc_spectrum_search_frequencies result. A number the record does not file starts at the next one it does. Pass this or a nonzero location_offset, not both; page on with nextLocationOffset.

location_offset.description: Location to start at, counted from 0 in location-number order; pass nextLocationOffset from the previous call to read the next locations. To start at a location number instead, pass location_number.

max_frequencies.description: Positive integer frequency-row budget across the locations this call lists; values above 1000 are clamped to 1000 with a notice. Rows beyond it are dropped from the last locations first. Large microwave and land-mobile licenses exceed the default.

usi.description: Unique system identifier, as digits: the usi field of fcc_spectrum_search_licenses, fcc_spectrum_find_transmitters, or fcc_spectrum_search_frequencies results. Pass this or callsign, not both.

name: fcc_spectrum_get_license

candidates.description: Up to 5 records whose callsign starts with the one requested; present when a callsign lookup found nothing.

dataAsOf.description: Creation time of the newest applied ULS file (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `index_not_ready`: No completed index generation is published yet. `identifier_required`: Neither or both of callsign and usi were supplied. `location_start_conflict`: location_number was supplied with a nonzero location_offset. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when a record matched; false returns guidance and candidates instead.

guidance.description: Why nothing matched and where to look next; present when found is false.

license.description: The record; present when found is true.

amateur.description: Amateur license details; present on amateur records.

operatorClassLabel.description: Label of the operator class code.

trusteeCallsign.description: Trustee callsign of a club, military-recreation, or RACES license.

trusteeName.description: Trustee name; null when redaction withholds it.

callsign.description: Callsign, or lease ID (L + 9 digits) on a lease.

isLease.description: True for a spectrum leasing arrangement.

lastActionDate.description: Date of the last ULS action (YYYY-MM-DD).

leaseCount.description: Total leases carved from this license.

leasedFrom.description: Licenses this lease is carved from; empty unless the record is a lease.

usi.description: Parent license USI; pass it as usi to read the parent.

leases.description: Leases carved from this license, up to 100 from lease_offset, in lease-ID order.

licensee.description: The licensee entity (the lessee on a lease).

applicantType.description: ULS applicant type code, when filed.

city.description: Mailing city, when filed and not redacted.

name.description: Licensee or lessee name as filed; null when redacted or not on file.

redacted.description: True when the licensee is an individual whose name and city are withheld.

role.description: lessee on a lease record, licensee otherwise.

market.description: Geographic-area license market; present on market-based records.

blocks.description: Spectrum blocks authorized in the market; kept only for status A, L, or X (active, pending legal, term pending), so empty otherwise.

channelWidthMhz.description: Channel width, MHz, of a block ULS files with no frequency (a 0 lower edge): 3.5 GHz Priority Access License channels, which the Spectrum Access System assigns within 3550–3650 MHz.

highMhz.description: Upper edge, MHz; absent on a block filed as a channel width only.

lowMhz.description: Lower edge, MHz; absent on a block filed as a channel width only.

partitionAreaIds.description: ULS partition areas this band is filed under; a partitioned license files one band per area, listed once here.

marketName.description: Market name as filed (cut at 30 characters by ULS).

radioServiceLabel.description: Label of the radio service code.

serviceGroup.description: FCC bulk-data service group the record was indexed from (e.g. "paging"); fcc_spectrum_list_reference topic "coverage" lists the groups.

statusLabel.description: Label of the license status code.

locationTotal.description: Location numbers the record files; present when found is true.

locations.description: Locations with antennas, frequency rows, and paths, one entry per location number (a number filed at several sites lists them in sites): whole locations from location_offset or location_number up to 50 sites, 100 antennas, and 100 paths (a path counted at its transmit location), or one larger location alone; present when found is true.

items.description: One license location number: one site, or several sites the license files under the same number.

address.description: Site street address; omitted on an individual licensee's record while redaction is on.

antennas.description: Antennas filed under this location number; with several sites, ULS does not say which site each antenna and frequency belongs to.

antennaNumber.description: Filed antenna number within the location; absent for an independently retained unnumbered AN record, which has no associated frequency rows.

antennaTypeCode.description: ULS antenna type code (H Hub, P Passive Repeater, R Final Receiver, T Transmit Antenna).

azimuthDeg.description: Azimuth of the main beam, degrees true.

frequencies.description: Frequency rows on this antenna, in filing order.

items.description: One authorized frequency row, as filed (adaptive-modulation filings repeat a frequency per step).

bandwidthMhz.description: Widest necessary bandwidth parsed from the emission designators, MHz; a designator 20% of the assigned frequency or wider is a filing error and is left out.

emissions.description: Emission designators filed for this frequency row.

stationClass.description: ULS class-of-station code, as filed (e.g. FB2, FXO); decode with fcc_spectrum_list_reference, topic "station_classes", filter set to this code. Unknown filed codes remain unchanged.

upperMhz.description: Upper edge when the assignment is a range, MHz.

heightToCenterM.description: Height to center of radiation above ground, meters.

heightToTipM.description: Height to antenna tip above ground, meters.

paths.description: Microwave paths this antenna transmits on, in filing order; present only on an antenna that transmits on a filed path. An antenna with a path but no antenna or frequency record is listed with only its number, empty frequencies, and paths.

items.description: One microwave path (PA record) this antenna transmits on, as filed.

passiveReceiver.description: True when the filing marks the receiver passive, false when not; absent when blank.

pathNumber.description: Path number as filed; not unique on a license, where a number can be filed more than once.

pathType.description: Path type as filed, e.g. "Fixed Point-to-Point" or "Area"; absent when blank.

receive.description: The receive end, resolved against this license's own location and antenna records; the receiving station's license is not read.

antennaFiled.description: false when this license files no antenna record under antennaNumber at the receive location; absent otherwise.

antennaNumber.description: Receive antenna number at that location; absent when the filing leaves it blank.

latitude.description: Receive site latitude, decimal degrees, from this license's own site record; present only when the license files exactly one site under the receive location number and its coordinates validate.

locationNumber.description: Location number of the receive end, on this license.

longitude.description: Receive site longitude, decimal degrees; present with latitude.

siteCount.description: Sites this license files under the receive location number, when not exactly one: 0 when it files none, 2 or more when the number is shared, and then no coordinates are given.

receiverCallsign.description: Receiving station's callsign as filed, neither normalized nor checked (some filings hold placeholders such as N/A); absent when blank. Pass it as callsign to fcc_spectrum_get_license to try reading the receiving license.

recordCount.description: AN records the license files under this location and antenna number, when more than one (usually one per site sharing the location number); fields that differ between them are omitted.

asrNumber.description: FCC Antenna Structure Registration number: seven digits, never the 9999999 placeholder; omitted when the filing holds anything else (the placeholder, N/A, an application file number).

groundElevationM.description: Ground elevation, meters above mean sea level.

latitude.description: Latitude, decimal degrees (NAD83 as filed); absent when the filed coordinates fail validation.

locationClassCode.description: ULS location class code, as filed.

locationClassLabel.description: FCC label of the filed location class; absent for an unknown code. This is authorization metadata, not actual on-air activity.

locationTypeCode.description: ULS location type code (F fixed, M mobile, …); absent when not filed.

locationTypeLabel.description: Label of the location type code.

longitude.description: Longitude, decimal degrees (NAD83 as filed); absent when the filed coordinates fail validation.

name.description: Site name, as filed; omitted on an individual licensee's record while redaction is on.

radiusKm.description: Radius of operation for an area location, km.

sites.description: Every site the license files under this location number, in filing order; present only when there are several, and then the location's own site fields are absent.

address.description: Site street address; omitted on an individual licensee's record while redaction is on.

asrNumber.description: FCC Antenna Structure Registration number: seven digits, never the 9999999 placeholder; omitted when the filing holds anything else (the placeholder, N/A, an application file number).

groundElevationM.description: Ground elevation, meters above mean sea level.

latitude.description: Latitude, decimal degrees (NAD83 as filed); absent when the filed coordinates fail validation.

locationClassCode.description: ULS location class code, as filed.

locationClassLabel.description: FCC label of the filed location class; absent for an unknown code. This is authorization metadata, not actual on-air activity.

locationTypeCode.description: ULS location type code (F fixed, M mobile, …); absent when not filed.

locationTypeLabel.description: Label of the location type code.

longitude.description: Longitude, decimal degrees (NAD83 as filed); absent when the filed coordinates fail validation.

name.description: Site name, as filed; omitted on an individual licensee's record while redaction is on.

radiusKm.description: Radius of operation for an area location, km.

state.description: Site state: as filed, or derived from the coordinates when the filing leaves it blank.

stateFromCoordinates.description: True when state was derived from the coordinates rather than filed.

structureType.description: Structure type code, as filed (e.g. TOWER, BTWR).

state.description: Site state: as filed, or derived from the coordinates when the filing leaves it blank.

stateFromCoordinates.description: True when state was derived from the coordinates rather than filed.

structureType.description: Structure type code, as filed (e.g. TOWER, BTWR).

nextLeaseOffset.description: Pass as lease_offset to read the leases after these; absent when none follow.

nextLocationOffset.description: Pass as location_offset to read the locations after these; absent when none follow.

notice.description: What this call left out and the call that reads it, where an unfiled location_number started the locations, or why an offset or location number listed nothing.

otherCallsignRecords.description: Other records under the same callsign (ULS reuses callsigns); present when found is true.

usi.description: USI of another record under the same callsign; pass it as usi to read that record.

pathTotal.description: Microwave paths the record files across all its locations; 0 when technicalRetained is false, since paths are kept only for status A, L, or X. Present when found is true, except on an index built before paths were indexed, where the notice reports the gap.

siteTotal.description: Sites the record files, each site of a shared location number counted; present when found is true.

technicalRetained.description: False when the status is not A, L, or X (active, pending legal, term pending): sites and frequencies are kept only for those, so locations is empty.

truncated.description: True when this call leaves part of the record out: locations after the ones listed, frequency rows beyond max_frequencies, or leases after the ones listed.

title: Get an FCC ULS license
